edits.anchor: Taiwan, mainland China (中国大陆) and large regions such as 加东/加西 are `country-region`; Hong Kong is `city`.
edits.text: Taiwan, mainland China (中国大陆) and large regions such as 加东/加西 are `country-region`; Hong Kong is `city`. Sub-national territories, strips and districts (加沙, 加沙地带) are `local-region`, never `country-region`, and every mention uses the same type so coreference chains match. 加沙 and 加沙地带 are separate local-region nodes, each with all its name tokens.

edits.anchor: Common nouns for people keep the source word 人, not `person`.
edits.text: The common noun 人 is the English concept `person`; a person described by a predicate is a `person` node with :ARG0-of the predicate. Lexicalized agent nouns (援助者, 遇难者) stay one concept and are not decomposed into 人 + event.

edits.anchor: (遇袭, 葬, 穿着, 不治身亡 kept as one predicate)
edits.text: (遇袭, 葬, 穿着 kept as one predicate; 葬 takes ARG0). 身亡 and 驶离 take -01. The sole participant of an intransitive 身亡, 移动, 逃命 or 葬 is ARG0 (never ARG1), and a mover is ARG0 of a motion verb

edits.anchor: Clauses contrasted by 而…则 or 则 are `contrast-91` with :ARG1/:ARG2, not `and`.
edits.text: Clauses joined by 而…则 with an explicit contrast are `contrast-91` with :ARG1/:ARG2; clauses with a bare 则 and no adversative connective are a plain `and`. 不是…而是… is the coordination `and-but` with :op1/:op2.
- Ordinal+classifier phrases (第二辆车, 第三次, 第二批) are an :ord ordinal-entity with :value and the classifier as :unit of the ordinal-entity, not of the noun; an elided head becomes implicit-argument.

- Possession by an organization or country of an entity (车队, 军队, 汽车) is written on the possessed entity as :possessor-of pointing to the owner. Each mention of the possessed entity in separate clauses is its own node. The demonstrative 该 is a :mod node.
- Temporal adverbs (立刻, 首先, 当时, 最终 as time) are :temporal on the event; degree adverbs (更, 很, 非常) are :degree. Modal auxiliaries (必须, 能够) are not concept nodes.

edits.rejected: shares text with the corpus: 以色列—哈马斯战
edits.text: - Names of events and wars (阿克萨洪水行动, 以色列—哈马斯战争) are one named entity with :name holding all tokens, including the final generic noun (行动, 战争); they are not predicates. Nationality modifiers (X籍) are `nationality` with :name using the full country name (美国, 加拿大). A named hospital is `facility` with :name including 医院.

- Repeated mentions of the same airstrike/attack/death event across sentences (空袭, 袭击, 事发, 命中, 身亡, including ordinal ones and anaphoric 此) are linked by :same-event; repeated vehicles (车, 汽车) and the country are linked by :same-entity to the first mention. Later partial groups of an earlier group (遗体) are :subset-of.

- The content of a demand (要求 complements) takes :partial-affirmative from the requesting event; a 要求 complement is temporally :after 要求. Party nouns (以方, 以色列方面) reuse the country node and get no node of their own.

suggestions: Provide the annotator a list of evaluator-accepted named-entity type conventions (e.g. local-region for Gaza) in the tool or description.
Several problems suggest gold inconsistencies in temporal direction (后 clauses, 要求 complements); review gold before further rules are added.
